item.title: West Bengal Governor C.V. Ananda Bose Resigns Ahead of Assembly Polls, R.N. Ravi Gets Additional Charge
item.description: GUWAHATI: C. V. Ananda Bose, on Thursday, March 5, resigned as the Governor of West Bengal after serving for about three-and-a-half years.
